global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible chashu pork and menma arranged atop. Served in a speckled blue bowl, it rests on a warm wooden surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Light wood grain table surface, smooth texture, natural warm tone, subtle linear patterns radiating outward.
regions.bowl: Blue speckled ceramic bowl with textured surface and thin metallic rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth appears creamy, pale yellow, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: pinkish, tender, circular with a white fat cap, slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale brown, slightly translucent, cylindrical pieces with visible fibrous texture and subtle surface ridges.
